verdict.rationale: Blaxel's own docs say new sandboxes deploy from images 'in seconds' and resume from standby in under 25ms. The SDK and REST API are documented for operating sandboxes, and API keys work across the APIs, CLI and SDK. The evidence never shows a single create call, and it never describes how sandboxes are isolated from each other or the host. missing for 10: an explicit one-call SDK/API sandbox creation example, documentation of the isolation model (e.g. microVM/container boundary), independent or hands-on corroboration of cold-start provisioning time.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up an isolated sandbox with one API/SDK call and get a live environment in seconds

citations.quote: Deploy new sandboxes from images in seconds.
Sandboxes resume from standby in under 25 milliseconds
API keys can be used in the Blaxel APIs, CLI and SDK.
Read, write, list, and delete files inside a Blaxel sandbox using a simple file system interface from the SDK, MCP server, or REST API.
